react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Non-blocking; will be enforced in future RN Web versions. Reference: multiple screens using shadowColor/shadowOffset (e.g., app/(tabs)/index.tsx orbCore, app/jarvis.tsx).
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; already flagged in prior iterations.
